name: Ticket intake and logging
trigger: Email, phone call, portal form or RMM alert arrives
frequency_volume_estimate: est. 3,000-5,000 tickets/month (about 0.6-1.0 per end user per month)
steps_today: Read the email or take the call
Create or match the ticket in the PSA
data_sensitivity: confidential (may contain PHI/NPI in free text)
pain_today: Retyping, wrong client or contact picked, PHI pasted into ticket bodies
human_in_the_loop_rule: Agent proposes client, contact and summary; dispatcher confirms before the ticket is saved. Free text is untrusted input.
repo_status: partial: workflows/triage reads synthetic tickets (fixtures/tickets/); intake parsing is Phase 2

name: Ticket triage: category, priority, queue
frequency_volume_estimate: est. same as W-SD-01: every ticket
steps_today: Pick category and priority against the SLA matrix
Route to a queue or technician
pain_today: Inconsistent priority, mis-routed tickets bounce between queues, slow first response
human_in_the_loop_rule: Suggestion only. Technician accepts or corrects; corrections become eval data. Ticket text can raise priority but can never change what may be done.
repo_status: exists (mocked): workflows/triage, evals/triage/report.md, workflows/triage/corrections.py

name: Duplicate and related ticket detection
frequency_volume_estimate: est. 5-10% of tickets are duplicates or follow-ups
steps_today: Search open tickets for the same user or symptom
pain_today: Two technicians work the same issue; client gets two answers
human_in_the_loop_rule: Agent suggests the match with reasons; a technician merges. Never auto-merge across clients.
repo_status: exists: built by B-21, B-23 (evidence in docs/COVERAGE_AUDIT.md); the map said: planned: Phase 2

name: Ticket summary for handoff and escalation
trigger: Escalation, shift change, or long ticket thread
steps_today: Write what was tried and what is next
pain_today: Next tier re-asks the user the same questions; context is lost
human_in_the_loop_rule: Read-only summary shown with the ticket entries it used; the receiving technician reads the source when it matters.

name: Draft reply to the end user from the knowledge base
